# Yahya Quran Academy

> A children's Quran site in Arabic and English: the full Uthmani text with
> verified teaching recitations, illustrated stories from the Quran, and the
> Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad told for ages 6-11. Every page is available
> in both languages at the same URL; append ?lang=en for English.

Non-commercial and educational. No automated mastery score is shown and no
stage unlocks on its own — a parent judges the child's recitation.

## Quran reader
- [The reader](https://yahyaquran.com/read): all 114 surahs in the Uthmani text, each with
  a verified teaching recitation. Individual surahs are at https://yahyaquran.com/read/1
  through https://yahyaquran.com/read/114.

## Stories from the Quran
- [Animals in the Quran — حيوانات في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/animals): 8 stories. Eight stories about animals the Quran names, and what they teach.
- [Women in the Quran — نساء في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/women): 8 stories. Inspiring examples of patience, faith, and wisdom from Quranic stories.
- [Stories of the Prophets — قصص الأنبياء](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/prophets): 17 stories. Seventeen stories from Adam to Muhammad.
- [People and Nations — شخصيات وأمم](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/nations): 9 stories. Nine stories about the nations and figures the Quran names, and what became of them.

## Seerah of the Prophet
- [Beginnings — Seeds of Light](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-1): 5 stories. Five stories from the childhood of the Prophet (pbuh): his birth, his years in the desert, the love of his grandfather and uncle, and the first work of his life.
- [The Truthful, The Trustworthy](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-2): 5 stories. Five stories from his youth before the revelation: his honesty in trade, his home with Khadijah, his wisdom over the Black Stone, his stand with the wronged, and his retreats to the cave of Hira.


### Beginnings — Seeds of Light
- [The Day Mecca Shone — يوم أشرقت مكة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/birth-of-light): سيرة ابن هشام، السيرة النبوية الصحيحة
- [The Pure Desert Breeze — هواء الصحراء النقي](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/desert-breeze): الرحيق المختوم، صحيح مسلم (أجزاء من القصة)
- [In the Shade of the Kaaba — في ظل الكعبة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/grandfather-love): سيرة ابن هشام، زاد المعاد
- [The Kind Uncle's House — بيت العم الحنون](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/uncle-home): الطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد، السيرة النبوية
- [The Little Shepherd — الراعي الصغير](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/little-shepherd): صحيح البخاري (حديث رعي الغنم)

### The Truthful, The Trustworthy
- [The Honest Merchant of Mecca — تاجر مكة الأمين](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-honest-merchant): السيرة النبوية لابن هشام
- [The Righteous Wife Khadijah — الزوجة الصالحة خديجة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/khadijah): صحيح البخاري، سيرة ابن هشام
- [The Wisdom of the Black Stone — حكمة الحجر الأسود](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-black-stone): مسند أحمد، سيرة ابن هشام
- [Helping the Oppressed — نصرة المظلوم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/hilf-al-fudul): سنن البيهقي، السيرة النبوية
- [Solitude and Reflection — الخلوة والتفكر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/cave-of-hira): صحيح البخاري (حديث عائشة عن بدء الوحي)

## In the Realm of the Quran
- [Discover the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts): one hundred short facts about the Quran
  for children — what it names, how it is arranged, and what is remarkable about
  it — presented as cards a child turns over one at a time.

## About and provenance
- [About the academy](https://yahyaquran.com/about): who built the site and why, in Arabic and English.
- The Quran text is the Uthmani script; the reader plays verified teaching
  recitations, and highlighting is shown only where the timing data covers the
  ayah — nothing is inferred to fill a gap.
- Each Seerah story carries its own source reference on the page.
- Every page's full text is in the HTML that is served, so this site can be read
  without executing JavaScript.
